instruction: Within Apple Notes, you should create a new note with the title "Travel Memo", then set its content to "Pack passport and charger.".
reference_command:
cat > /tmp/memo_auto_add.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
file="$1"

cat > "$file" <<'TXT'
Travel Memo

Pack passport and charger.
TXT
EOF

chmod +x /tmp/memo_auto_add.sh
EDITOR=/tmp/memo_auto_add.sh memo notes --folder "Work" --add
